_comment: The nightly ops report's model (apps/ops-report): the customers' fleets the routing platform planned for, the platform's baselines, and what happened on particular nights. The tile generates each night's numbers from these baselines with a deterministic per-night variation, so a report is the same whenever it is rendered. Imported by hack/demo/seed.sh (POST /import), which renders the last 14 nights; the cron job renders each new night at 05:30.

notes: Pinewood pilot week 1 started: 22 routes on the Grand Rapids yard.

incident.title: Geocoder timeouts for 17 minutes
incident.impact: Lakeshore's evening re-plan ran 6 minutes late

notes: Driver app 4.11 rolled out to 100% of drivers.
Ticket spike after the 4.11 rollout: Android 15 drivers logged out mid-route (Alder Street, Granary Row).
Kettle Creek renewed for 2027 with the driver app.
Route-plan cache warmed before the 04:00 batch; plan p95 down to 1.9 s.
Riverbend's Green Bay depot ran its first night on Larkspan in shadow mode.

incident.title: One planner worker restarted (out of memory)
incident.impact: No customer impact; the batch retried in 40 s

notes: Brightwell's Dayton DC ran its first night on the new depot hand-off rules: 97.1% on time.
Fix for Android 15 logouts (4.12) is in staged rollout: 20% of drivers.
